offering_description.value: Produces and markets branded packaged foods, including shelf-stable meals, refrigerated meat products, poultry and snacks. Sells to grocery retailers, foodservice operators and distributors. Makes products in its own plants from sourced pork, turkey and other ingredients.

primary_products.value: shelf-stable canned meats and meals; bacon, sausage and hams; deli meats; turkey and poultry products; nut snacks and spreads

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery retailers, club stores, foodservice operators, restaurants, distributors; B2C: household consumers buying packaged foods at retail

end_markets.value: grocery retail; foodservice; convenience; international food markets

revenue_model.value: product sales: packaged meats, meals, poultry and snack foods sold to retailers and foodservice customers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: processes pork, turkey and other raw ingredients into packaged foods, sold to retailers and foodservice; brand owner: owns consumer and foodservice food brands marketed to retailers and consumers

geography_served.value: global: United States primarily, plus exports and operations in Asia, Latin America, Europe and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: retail and foodservice packaged meats, shelf-stable meals, poultry and nut snacks sharing customers and channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales force selling to grocery chains, club stores and large foodservice accounts; distributors / dealers: foodservice distributors and wholesalers; third-party retail: supermarkets, mass merchants and club stores carrying its brands
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: meat and poultry processing under USDA FSIS inspection, FDA food safety, labeling, animal welfare and environmental rules
